data.title:
5 Local SEO basics
to *get you found* locally
data.sub: Swipe to see if your site qualifies →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: Claim your *Google Business* Profile
data.body: This is the most important step to appear on Google Maps. It tells locals exactly where you operate and how to reach you.
data.fix: Fix: Verify your business on Google Business Profile today.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Keep your *NAP* consistent
data.body: NAP stands for Name, Address, and Phone. If these vary across the web, Google gets confused and won't show your site.
data.fix: Fix: Ensure your contact info matches on your site and social.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Ask for *customer reviews*
data.body: Positive feedback builds trust with both potential clients and Google. It is the fastest way to rank higher than competitors.
data.fix: Fix: Email your last three clients asking for a review.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: Mention your *target city*
data.body: Include your city and state in your website's header and footer. This tells search engines exactly where you serve customers.
data.fix: Fix: Add your city name to your website footer.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Make it *mobile friendly*
data.body: Most people searching for local services are on their phones. If your site is hard to use, they will leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Open your site on your phone to test navigation.
